scope: local validation; active server code and process not replaced or interrupted

changes.working_copy_readiness: process-local receipt bound to hash-verified copy and schema
changes.final_original_check: all-file SHA256 and strong snapshots; no repeated SQLite or stream parsing
changes.output_verification: unchanged full decode and independent source audit
changes.maintenance: durable drain completes active publication and cleanup; explicit resume; queue preserved

performance_limit: Local SSD timings are not a server speedup benchmark; full final content hashes and output checks remain required.
first_release_upgrade: Validate a source-only archive outside the running checkout; SIGTERM and wait for normal exit before copying; preserve runtime, configuration, queue and output datasets.
